ranked_facts.why: the presence of fluid-filled vesicles is more characteristic of varicella (chickenpox) than of an allergic reaction, as varicella typically presents with vesicular lesions, whereas allergic reactions usually present with morbilliform or urticarial lesions

the combination of macules, papules, and crusted lesions is more typical of viral exanthems, such as varicella or measles, than of an allergic reaction, which usually presents with a more uniform morbilliform rash
